_comment: EARNED, not aspired to. A profile lands here only after a run proved the number; each raise is a deliberate commit. A profile that is absent prints a baseline and passes — the first measurement of anything must not fail a build.
_keys: One row per persona. While the 500-row sample and this retrieval were both alive the rows were keyed '<persona> · <retrieval>' so ratcheting the better path could not fail the worse one. The sample is deleted.

Rupanjana Mitra._note: Whole-corpus retrieval, now what /market serves. 68% of the yardstick is reachable and 35% is shown; the 33% between them is the 2-per-employer cap, where both sides keep two and disagree on WHICH two — a ranking fault, not a reach one. Every one of the 12 remaining violations has the same single cause: years_experience is NULL for every account older than 2026-09-24, so a mid-band person gets the band's [2,5] instead of her own [2.2,4.2] and roles asking 5 reach the list. The forward pass reads it off her banked CV on her next visit; this number should fall on its own as people return.
